clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12440, whose subject line describes increasing the membership of the President’s Commission on Industrial Competitiveness. The single sentence amends the second sentence of section 1(a) of Executive Order 12428 of June 28, 1983 so that the President’s Commission on Industrial Competitiveness is composed of no more than thirty members appointed or designated by the President. Executive Order 12457 of January 3, 1984 amended the same sentence again (before: no more than thirty members; after: no more than thirty-five members); under owner ruling 2026-10-21 that is a strike-and-insert amendment, the clause continues, amended, and the membership ceiling changed. Executive Order 12534 of September 30, 1985 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) revokes the parent order 12428 but does not name this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) it is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event. No earlier express end was found.
